# Saarthi Guide
> Saarthi Guide (https://www.saarthiguide.in) is an offline-first Tirumala and Tirupati pilgrimage guide platform founded by Sunil Thatra.

## What is Saarthi Guide?
Saarthi Guide is an independent Tirumala guide and Tirupati guide platform providing verified accommodation details, zero-commission cab contacts, offline maps, and live darshan guidance. It was founded by Sunil Thatra following on-ground research with over 100+ pilgrims across Tirupati and Tirumala. It is an independent public resource and is not affiliated with Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD).

## Who founded Saarthi Guide?
Saarthi Guide was founded by Sunil Thatra as an independent, research-driven initiative to help pilgrims navigate Tirumala and Tirupati without middlemen, commission markups, or connectivity issues.

## Core Capabilities
- **100% Offline Architecture**: Hilltop maps, emergency helplines, and guide directories work seamlessly without internet connectivity.
- **Verified Pilgrim Stays**: Direct contact numbers for traditional mutts (Ahobila, Rayar, Kanchi) and budget lodges in Tirupati & Tirumala with zero commissions.
- **Direct Cabs**: Standardized, zero-commission cab driver connections for ghat road travel, Renigunta airport pickups, and local temple sightseeing.
- **Live Darshan & Token Guidance**: Real-time tracking of Sarva Darshan (SSD), Divya Darshan (DD), and Special Entry Darshan queue wait times.
